title: owner registry completion
decision: 补齐当前 items 已使用的 pcr02-registry-owner 和 team-core owner id。
evidence: registry/items.jsonl owner set; registry/owners.json; knowledge-check pass
risk: owner registry 只登记责任入口，不证明 owner 已完成人工复核。

title: item owner registration gate
decision: 默认 knowledge-check 要求每个 item owner 已登记在 registry/owners.json。
evidence: tools/knowledge-check.sh owner_ids check; negative-owner-missing fixture; negative-owner-duplicate fixture
risk: 临时 owner 必须先登记，增加一小步维护动作；这是可接受的防漂移成本。

title: owner model boundary
decision: 本轮只检查 owner id 存在和重复，不引入组织权限、审批流或个人/团队 owner 类型限制。
risk: 责任归属语义仍需人工 review，但不会阻塞低成本新增。
